result.stdout:
ACSync - Incremental Update System

Usage:
  acsync <path> -l                  Create manifest for directory
  acsync <path> -u [-e ext1,ext2]   Apply patch to directory
  acsync <oldpath> <newpath> -m     Create patch from old to new

Options:
  -e, --exclude   Comma-separated extensions to skip during update
                  Example: -e .json,.ini,.yaml
